note: The script asks for two graphics: the WHAT CAN YOU OFFER? hook text, which stays on into row 00:04–00:12 until “what you can offer”, and the Comment “I'm in” ask text. The logo is only on the end card.

mg.title: What can you offer
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top, above the picture: WHAT CAN YOU OFFER? Cut on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until he says “what you can offer”, about 00:06. Keep it at the top, above the picture.

mg.title: Comment I'm in
mg.cue: Ask text on screen: Comment “I'm in”. Big, center, on the word “comment”. Holds to the end card.
mg.use: Put it on at the word “comment”, about 00:24, big in the center. Hold it until the end card at 00:27.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Logo swishes in (about 10 frames), settles, holds. Same animation on all 12 videos. Make it once, reuse it. Nothing under the logo.
mg.src: The Journey Home logo from the client's own slides in Dwayne's Day 2 pm.mov (uploaded 6 Oct 2026), as the script asks.
